_description: Executive Strategic — designed for directors, VPs, C-suite, and candidates with 10+ years of experience. Opens with a 2-3 line executive positioning statement (not an objective), followed by core leadership competencies, then career narrative. Bold navy left-border on section headings signals authority. Two pages expected. Research: ResumeGo study (482 recruiters, 7,712 resumes) found two-page resumes chosen 2.3x more often than one-page for experienced candidates. HBR 2024 notes growing emphasis on social/strategic skills at C-suite level alongside P&L and scale.
_edit_instructions: Change color_accent and color_heading to the same value to change the left-border accent color. font_size_name can be increased to 26 for very senior roles. All values are 6-digit hex without the # symbol.
